question: Which side has the more natural, coherent and useful colour-edge acuity without artifact?
tie_rule: tie or no visible difference counts as no candidate preference
observations: No pair showed a reliable unamplified one-to-one natural acuity advantage.
Knowing that automatic edge metrics passed did not make an A/B identity visually distinguishable.
No coloured speckle, posterization, secondary contour, edge echo, clipping, seam or geometry failure was observed.
scope: autonomous visual evidence, not human or population preference
